summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature test of Rantau on live preview URL. Covered: admin resource approval UI (Pending tab + badge, approve, reject-with-confirm), per-user visibility of pending submissions, hiding of pending for logged-out visitors, homepage WeeklyDigest (default Toulouse, Paris switch empty states, localStorage persistence, city-link to /cities/paris, logged-in auto-pick of profile.city=Toulouse), resource library regression (15 approved cards, MARA present, no Khazanah, search 'CAF' = 2, sort recent). Mobile 390px overflow previously reported in iteration_1 is now fixed on / and /resources (scrollWidth == clientWidth = 390). All new flows pass end-to-end.

issues: Native browser <input type="date"> date pickers used for 'from/to' filters instead of a shadcn/consistent calendar component.
Transient Firestore WebChannel 'unavailable' warnings in console on first navigation; Firebase SDK recovers automatically. Not blocking but noisy.

critical_code_review_comments: Resources.jsx: approved + mine + pending are merged into a single `all` list in-memory then filtered by tab, which means a signed-in user whose pending submission is in `mine` will still 'leak' into the 'All' tab for themselves (expected UX per spec), but future admin-only 'approved' sorting could be more defensive. Current behaviour is correct.

WeeklyDigest.jsx: `useEffect` writes profile city via cityIdFromName but does NOT also persist to localStorage; on next load without profile, previous localStorage value wins. Minor but could surprise users switching accounts. Acceptable.

db.js approveResource/deleteResource: no role check client-side (relies on Firestore rules). Firestore rules currently open test-mode — must enforce `request.auth.token.role=='admin'` before production.
Native date inputs on /events — switch to shadcn Calendar for consistent UX.
